morphology.pattern_note: 地名整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。规范书写应大写为 Jericho；所列音节与 IPA 对应英语名称，不是已核定的马来语读音。未确认官方马来语词条身份，故不标为 official；Jawi 保留空值。

senses.zh_definition: 耶利哥；巴勒斯坦约旦河谷的一座城市，附近有古耶利哥／苏丹台形遗址。
senses.en_definition: Jericho, a city in the Jordan Valley in Palestine, associated with the ancient settlement of Tell es-Sultan.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas sebuah bandar di Lembah Jordan, Palestin, yang dikaitkan dengan tapak purba Tell es-Sultan.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词，不是表示普通事物的马来语词。资料包没有提供官方马来语释义，以上为编辑性说明。缺少上下文时不能排除同名人物、作品或其他地点；此处采用主要地名义。地理说明参见 [UNESCO：Ancient Jericho/Tell es-Sultan](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1687/)。

dual_scenarios.en: The presentation discusses the significance of ancient Jericho in the study of human settlement.

etymology.historical_story: Jericho preserves an ancient place-name whose meaning remains uncertain; proposed connections include Hebrew words for moon and fragrance. Its archaeological setting offers a firmer memory anchor: Tell es-Sultan preserves evidence of early settled life beside a perennial spring. Remember the ancient city without treating any proposed interpretation of its name as settled fact. [Name history](https://places.behindthename.com/name/jericho), [UNESCO](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1687/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Jericho＝耶利哥：把三拍读音配上“一座古城、一眼泉水”的画面。名称不作马来语词根拆分。
